falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 4% above the verdict-date close and VIX closes below 14 on three consecutive sessions within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug analog has already confirmed a durable risk-on reversal, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was the wrong call and should have been a long/risk-on verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5% below the verdict-date close, or high-yield OAS widens by 75 bps or more versus the verdict-date level, within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom analog is broken by fresh downside or credit stress, so HOLD was wrong and the correct call was risk-off rather than an unresolved bottom.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 50%, or the blowoff score rises from 38 to above 65, within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The analog that justified standing aside no longer holds, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is invalidated and must be replaced by a directional verdict.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
